basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Engineer · Production LLM & Agentic Systems · Founder · MBA
basics.summary: Unconventional engineer, long-term capital-markets investor who runs risk and allocation with his own AI systems, believer that one person can still move the world a little. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps shipping production multi-agent systems on GCP that 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue, grounded by a temporal knowledge graph so agents stop hallucinating on enterprise data. 13+ years in production behind it: $337K LLM cost eliminated at Beekeeper, autonomous drones at Dronistics, AI research at EPFL, plus SwissNRI (AI cross-border tax) on the side.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Delivered production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales end to end, from discovery through production handover: Python, LangGraph and Google ADK on GCP Vertex AI, tools exposed over MCP, ReAct and hierarchical delegation, agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day; forecast $1M in quarterly revenue at 25% conversion.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, per-agent access contracts, and a freshness layer that grounds RAG retrieval and cuts hallucinations.

Instrumented the full stack for enterprise governance: eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request telemetry, and on-call for global production. Reports to C-level on adoption, quality, ROI, cost, and risk.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, quality gates and cost caps built in; product team iterates without external gatekeepers.
Architected Employee Referral System end to end, from problem definition to production. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR, 99.99% SLA for enterprise customers.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist, a personalized LLM guide that gives every new signup high-touch setup at scale. 100% of customers guided, time-to-first-value reduced without adding headcount.

Built GenAI demo system for sales: LLM extraction over Salesforce data auto-generates personalized pitch content. Ran observability and on-call for global production (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io), hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production; advised multiple fintech portfolio companies on AI strategy and technical architecture.
Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries. Enterprise-grade reliability enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms: 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Rare research direction where morphology and neural control evolve together through artificial selection.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational applied AI (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that informs how I approach modern LLM and agentic systems today.

projects.description: Real-time market intelligence built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Now serving live users on real-time feeds.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file, with regulatory guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: Independent forward deployed engineering practice, currently the home for the AI products I design, build, and run on my own (PulseView, SwissNRI, Proplab). Take my own products from zero to production end to end: multi-agent systems, RAG grounding, eval pipelines, and observability, the same playbook I bring to any engagement.

Build production-grade LLM-powered products end-to-end: RAG, agents, extraction, evaluation, open-source model deployment and fine-tuning. Requires 2-6 years ML/AI in production, hands-on RAG with security/observability/cost governance, open-source model deployment, LoRA/PEFT fine-tuning, strong Python, and ability to translate ambiguous business needs into measurable outcomes. Financial services exposure preferred.
_jobApplication.notes: Visionary summary aligned with CEO quote: 'To build differently, we need people who are built differently, who take ownership and have the courage to challenge the status quo.'
